description: Create an alert rule. Creates a metric-threshold alert rule. `name`, `metricId`, `comparator`, and `threshold` are required; `windowHours` defaults to `24`, `severity` to `warn`, and `enabled` to `true`.

comparator.description: How the metric value is compared to the threshold (gt/gte/lt/lte).

enabled.description: Whether the rule is evaluated by the cron.

listToken.description: REQUIRED. The `listToken` returned by the most recent `ops_alerts_list` call. It proves you listed existing ops alerts and confirmed this one doesn't already exist before creating it. Call `ops_alerts_list` first if you don't have a fresh token.

metricId.description: Id of the metric to evaluate.

name.description: Human label for the rule, shown on the alert and the rules list.

notify.description: Delivery target for a notification; `null` = use the project default.

threshold.description: Threshold the metric value is compared against.

windowHours.description: Lookback window (hours) the metric is aggregated over. 1–720.

name: ops_alerts_create
